phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F5 Phase D — Component-Aware Exact Rank Audit

interpretation: The 42 unique component variables are exactly the 11 directly recovered F511 cells plus 31 F52 cells fixed either by source evidence or the established investment-fund issuer scope.
Four applicable F52 cells remain non-unique per measure: F→F, F→X, BNR→F and BNR→X.
No combination F511+F512+F519 is invariant for any bilateral cell, so no F51 total cell is identified.
No combination F511+F512+F519+F52 is invariant for any bilateral cell, so no total-F5 cell is identified.

scientific_interpretation: The F5 limitation is identification, not a failure of the aggregate accounting identities: F5=F51+F52 and F51=F511+F512+F519 remain validated at the available aggregate levels.

The component-aware system deliberately preserves lower-level information rather than discarding the 11 F511 and 31 F52 unique variables, but none of that information is sufficient to identify an entire F51 or F5 bilateral cell.
Because F512 and F519 are large and bilaterally unpublished, promoting F511 or F51 proxies would materially distort the instrument structure.
Exact rational nullspace analysis provides no unconditional partial total-F5 core to materialize.
reopen_conditions: official bilateral or counterpart-sector publication for F512 and/or F519
additional official component controls that reduce the exact component nullspace enough to make a total-F51 or total-F5 cell invariant
a separately justified instrument-specific structural applicability rule supported by ESA/source evidence, never an empirical convenience assumption
